messages:
mira: FYI — Meridian Health (pilot) raised an intake: they want us to pin 'medgpt-lite-3' v1.2 in EU with APAC fallback. They specifically asked for the q4_0 quantized variant for cost, fallback to a q2_0 variant if needed. Also asking about SLA 99.9 and possibility of private deploy later. timeline: sales asking for ~4–6 weeks. See intake form: https://redwood.internal/intakes/6789

alex: Thanks. Quick clarifying Qs — is medgpt-lite-3 an open checkpoint or vendor binary? any red flags from their initial evals re: medical hallucinations / PII?

mira: It's an open checkpoint hosted on HF (MIT license). Customer ran basic local evals, flags low hallucination rates in their data. They noted tokenizer differences in some prompts. Intake form has notes.

julian: For cataloging we'll need the HF repo link + commit hash + tokenizer files. Also need to define a pin policy: prefer q4_0, fallback q2_0, and an explicit degraded-routing label. Capacity-wise APAC for 7B families is tighter atm.

dan: APAC capacity note: apac-sg currently has limited 7B pooled GPUs. We can support canary traffic but for scale we either (a) raise quota or (b) route to a smaller quantized variant (q2_0) in apac. Quant verification required — we should run a quick accuracy delta check after quantization.

eve: Health customer -> compliance checklist. For any PHI use we need DPA + HIPAA conversation. Private deploy will be required if they plan to ingest PHI; for hosted pilot EU residency must be enforced (no cross-region routing).

alex: Proposed launch criteria (draft):
- artifacts + license check
- quantization smoke test: latency, perf, quality delta < threshold
- safety eval (medical prompt suite) passed
- region pin config + routing policy defined
- legal/compliance sign-off
Anything missing?

julian: Add: model-card + tokenizer mismatch check. If tokenizer tokens differ we need a conversion step or explicit docs. Also verify HF tokenizer vs runtime tokenizer.

dan: Rollout plan idea:
1) Canary in eu-west with token cap (10k/day)
2) Monitor latency, token cost, quality metrics
3) If capacity exceeded in eu-west, route to apac-sg but only to q2_0 variant and mark requests with header X-Model-Fallback: apac-q2
4) Webhook alerts on fallback events

mira: :thumbsup: Meridian is ok with canary and token cap. Sales wants an ETA of 4 weeks for a pilot though. Can engineering commit to that?

alex: Rough estimate: 3w for cataloging + quant tests + safety eval (parallelize where possible) + 1w for canary rollout & monitoring = ~4w. If they need >5 concurrent steady connections we will need an infra capacity bump for apac.

eve: Also add to backlog: compliance doc pack for Private later (SOC2/HIPAA references). I'll start the compliance intake.

dan: I'll open infra ticket and tag priority:customer-pilot; will include capacity numbers and cost estimate.

intake-bot: New intake recorded: https://redwood.internal/intakes/6789 — Meridian Health; model: medgpt-lite-3 v1.2; regions requested: eu-west-1, apac-sg; quant preference: [q4_0, q2_0]; canary_tokens=10000.

alex: Next steps: julian to take artifacts + run tokenizer check, dan to own infra ticket & quant smoke test, eve to start compliance/contract thread, mira to manage customer expectations (4w pilot). I'll own rollout checklist and notify SRE for canary.

mira: Thanks — I'll update CRM + loop in account exec and set expectation. Will upload HF link and artifact hash to the intake ticket.
